summary: Improved Focus questions and scheduled tasks, restored context and subscription details, and refreshed Settings and appearance controls.

items.title: Focus questions and scheduled tasks
items.description: Updated pending questions to show Input by default and reveal Answer on hover or keyboard focus. Opening a question displayed it above the current composer and routed replies to the chat that asked without leaving the chat in view. Hiding the card left the question pending. Limited Focus alarms to scheduled tasks, including settled tasks, with Run now as the only alarm action. Running a daily task early added a one-time run and preserved its saved schedule in both Focus and Tasks.

items.title: Settings and token activity
items.description: Refreshed Settings backgrounds, sidebars, Profile colors, and dropdowns in both themes. Restored scrollable loading skeletons for All chats and Action usage, and showed an error when Action usage failed to load. Removed User manual from General and Settings search.

items.title: Project and folder appearance
items.description: Redesigned Appearance → Project/Folder with a compact layout and neutral Lucide icons. Suggestions used the folder name and top-level filenames; Refresh showed five different symbols without changing the selection. Selected icons updated the existing Focus sidebar slot, custom uploads were preserved, and saved generated icons mapped to Lucide equivalents.

items.title: Performance telemetry control
items.description: Added a Settings toggle to enable or disable PostHog performance telemetry. Telemetry was enabled by default in the desktop app.

items.title: Chat replies and steering
items.description: Corrected the Chat agent type and filtered the false “Agent connection did not start” warning from saved chats and completed replies. Steer now interrupted the active reply and started a direct response with the new guidance and conversation history, while keeping text already shown in the feed.

items.title: Context counts and provider caches
items.description: Kept context usage measured against the selected model after switching models, and removed the approximate-count prefix from chat, Work Panel, and Settings. The cache badge followed the current request, and Gemini cache recovery no longer discarded a newly rebuilt cache.

items.title: Subscription settings
items.description: Restored the Subscription provider panel, account controls, and subscription limit alerts.

items.title: Update status and announcements
items.description: Removed the automatic Update available card that appeared when a release was detected. Settings → Updates now cleared its green success banner six seconds after it first appeared and did not show that same update's banner again on later launches. Updated the announcement dialog's dark background to match the supplied reference.
